notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Cast Bill the Pony by paying {W}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Bill the Pony enters the battlefield, it and Samwise trigger.
Resolve the Samwise trigger, creating a Food artifact token.
Resolve the Bill the Pony trigger, creating two Food artifact tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bill the Pony, adding {W}.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing three Foods, returning Bill the Pony to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.
